item.title: Watch live: State of the Union
item.description: President Donald Trump is giving his State of the Union address. He’s slated to champion his immigration crackdowns, his slashing of the federal government, his push to preserve widespread tariffs that the Supreme Court just struck down and his ability to direct quick-hit military actions around the world, including in Iran and Venezuela.

item.title: State of the Union offers Trump a chance to make the case for his foreign policy approach
item.description: He's making the case to Americans who are increasingly uneasy about his priorities.

item.title: H.S. GIRLS BASKETBALL: Schuylkill Haven, Williams Valley advance to District 11 Championship
item.description: POTTSVILLE — Williams Valley and Schuylkill Haven cruised to District 11 Championships on Tuesday with semifinal wins at Martz Hall. item.title: H.S. BOYS BASKETBALL: Pottsville upset by Southern Lehigh in Class 5A semifinals
item.description: It’s often said in basketball that when a team likes to shoot the three, you live and die by the sword. item.title: H.S. GIRLS BASKETBALL: Marian clinches PIAA playoff spot, district title game berth in win over Lincoln Leadership
item.description: The Marian Catholic Fillies will officially have an opportunity to add another district championship to their rich history later this week. On Tuesday evening at Blue Mountain High School in Orwigsburg, the Fillies defeated Allentown-based Lincoln Leadership Academy 59-30 to move on to the District 11 Class 2A championship game.
